name: Global Dollar
oneLiner: USDG is Paxos's MAS-regulated Global Dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 in USD through Paxos Singapore with reserves at DBS and Standard Chartered.
collateral: U.S. dollar deposits, short-duration U.S. government securities, and other high-quality liquid assets held in segregated custodial accounts at DBS Bank and Standard Chartered
pegMechanism: Direct 1:1 redemption for U.S. dollars through Paxos Digital Singapore for KYC-verified users; reserves fully segregated and held at custodian banks; EU issuance by Paxos Issuance Europe OY under MiCA

sources.label: KPMG USDG Redemption Assets Report - May 2026

applicabilityBasis.summary: USDG is a MAS-regulated U.S. dollar stablecoin with 1:1 redemption through Paxos Digital Singapore and monthly reserve attestations.

genius.notes: USDG's primary issuing entity is Paxos Digital Singapore (MAS-regulated), with EU issuance by Paxos Issuance Europe Oy (FIN-FSA/MiCA). The GENIUS Act was enacted July 18, 2025, but its PPSI licensing framework remains in proposed-rulemaking phase as of June 2026 with no PPSI approvals granted to any issuer. On December 12, 2025 the OCC conditionally approved Paxos Trust Company, N.A. for a national trust bank charter conversion (from NYDFS); however Paxos confirmed USDG is issued by Paxos Digital Singapore, not Paxos Trust Company, so this OCC charter does not constitute a PPSI authorization for USDG. No public GENIUS Act application, foreign-issuer registration, or comparable-jurisdiction determination has been found for USDG.

mintAuthority.summary: USDG is issuer-minted by Paxos-operated infrastructure; the Ethereum token uses a UUPS ERC1967Proxy and delegates supply control to a SupplyControl contract. The SupplyControl owner and the token's defaultAdmin are a TimelockController (24h delay) whose sole proposer and executor is the Paxos admin EOA. The mint and upgrade paths were confirmed at block 25526176.

upgradeability.controlRef: USDG SupplyControl owner / token defaultAdmin (TimelockController, 24h delay)

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757, supplyControl() on the USDG token (selector 0x4a254dfe) returned 0x9a7164112029b81c07636AB7b59fA813E0883BBF. eth_getCode confirms the SupplyControl is a contract. SupplyControl owner() = 0x9036566eaa5f83e0b9e1161c6c602b0adf997654 (TimelockController, see next control). USDG defaultAdmin() also returned the TimelockController address.

sources.label: Paxos USDG contract and upgrade documentation

controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25526176, SupplyControl owner()/defaultAdmin() and USDG defaultAdmin() returned this TimelockController, whose getMinDelay() returned 86400 seconds. The USDG EIP-1967 implementation slot resolved to 0xfacd5ff359adf87822374275699dd518aaf9a65f and its admin slot was zero. Paxos documents the UUPS design, and the verified USDG implementation restricts _authorizeUpgrade to DEFAULT_ADMIN_ROLE. Prior role review found the Paxos admin EOA as the TimelockController's sole proposer and executor.

sources.label: MAS Paxos Digital Singapore institution record

review.evidence: At Ethereum block 25294757: supplyControl() = 0x9a7164... (contract confirmed); SupplyControl owner() and defaultAdmin() = 0x9036566... (OZ TimelockController, 24h delay, proposer+executor = Paxos EOA 0x3Af3e85...); eth_getCode on Paxos EOA confirms no bytecode. Data drift: prior data listed the Paxos EOA as the SupplyControl owner; the TimelockController has since been interposed. All controls updated to current chain state. Supervision and reconciliation re-verified 2026-07-17: the May 2026 KPMG report documents that PDS executed a Letter of Undertaking with MAS as a condition of its Major Payment Institution licence (granted 2024-07-01) imposing prudential reserve-asset composition and safeguarding requirements, that PIE issues under a FIN-FSA Electronic Money Institution licence (2022-11-23) compliant with MiCA e-money-token requirements, and that Exhibit C reconciles redemption assets against USDG redeemable tokens outstanding at each monthly report date (2026-05-11 and 2026-05-29: assets exceeded tokens by 0.10% and 0.25%); the MAS FID record for PDS was re-checked the same day.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: USDG is Paxos-issued and Paxos's official USDG mainnet documentation lists native deployments on Ethereum, Solana, Ink, X Layer, Arbitrum, and Robinhood Chain, each with a Paxos-operated SupplyControl contract. USDG on Hyperliquid is USDG0, the omnichain representation issued by Paxos Labs over LayerZero OFT, not a native Paxos deployment. Native routes are reviewed as issuer-native multichain issuance/redemption; the Hyperliquid USDG0 route is reviewed as an issuer-affiliated LayerZero OFT representation. Pinned totalSupply reads on 2026-07-21 sum to 3,244,471,126.287402 USDG across Paxos's six official native deployments. X Layer holds 1,852,539,363.075967 USDG, or 57.09834642% of that native supply, so the chain:xlayer common-mode exposure is measured and remains above the 10% materiality threshold. USDG0 is excluded from this denominator because it is a representation rather than additional Paxos-native issuance.
